title: Establish deterministic workflow contract verification
description:
Every critical GitHub workflow is checked through one maintained static-and-dynamic harness rather than bespoke or hypothetical failure fixtures.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A pinned actionlint binary validates all committed workflow YAML, and a repository-owned parser performs deterministic structural assertions over parsed triggers, workflow_call inputs/outputs, needs edges, permissions, candidate/publication ownership, and forbidden failure escapes or public-publish steps. It recursively scans critical workflow and local-composite uses: entries and rejects every non-local Action or reusable workflow reference that is not an exact 40-character hexadecimal commit SHA.
- [hard] REQ-02: One documented harness interface lets security, normal CI, candidate assembly, Docker, and publication workflows declare their required static graph assertions and controlled failing job without copying a verifier into each workflow.
- [hard] REQ-03: Disposable namespaced GitHub PR and tag fixtures call the reusable workflows with deterministic failure injection, record run URLs/IDs, and prove the caller fails, all downstream candidate/publication jobs remain unstarted, and no release, npm, or GHCR identity changes.
- [hard] REQ-04: The static checks run locally and on every pull request; the dynamic disposable-repository/ref fixtures run in a GitHub-hosted protected test environment and are required for changes to critical workflow contracts, with fixture refs and artifacts cleaned after evidence capture.
- [hard] REQ-05: The migration replaces every movable external uses: reference on CI, security, candidate, Docker, tag-authorizer, and publication paths with a reviewed full SHA plus a human-readable upstream-version comment. Pin-update pull requests must identify the upstream release/tag-to-SHA resolution, changelog and permission changes, pass all static/dynamic fixtures, and receive release-maintainer review; automation may propose but never auto-merge an update.

## Notes

Blast radius: one focused workflow-contract script/test directory, its pinned actionlint setup, all critical workflow/local-composite external `uses:` pins, the controlled pin-update policy, and a non-publishing fixture workflow; no product or release-channel behavior changes.
